entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie, I need to start a return for a jersey I bought a while back.
I can certainly help with that. Do you have your order number handy?

Great, one moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Men's Aero Jersey, delivered about 85 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference, I suppose. I tried it on and it's simply the wrong size. It's much too tight in the shoulders, and I'd like to exchange it.

I understand. Let me just double-check our policy for you... Okay, good news. Since the jersey is a standard apparel item, it falls within our 90-day return window. You're all set to send it back for an exchange or a full refund.

That's great to hear. Now, since I have to go through the trouble of packaging this up and sending it back, and then waiting for the new one, could you perhaps add a small discount to my exchange order for the inconvenience?

I appreciate you asking, but our policy for a size exchange is a straightforward swap or a full refund to your original payment method. We aren't able to add discounts to the replacement order. I can, however, generate a pre-paid shipping label for you right now so it won't cost you anything to send it back.
I see. Okay, the pre-paid label is fair. Let's go ahead with the exchange for one size up. The label is fine.

Excellent. I've just initiated the exchange process and sent that pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Just drop it off with the carrier, and once we receive it, we'll ship out the new size immediately. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Charlie.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
